name: LionStreams
description: Two tiny Arduino Stream adapters for embedded C++. StringStream is a read/write Stream view over an external String. ServerStream buffers Print output and flushes it in chunks to a synchronous web server (ESP8266WebServer / ESP32 WebServer), so large HTML pages are generated without holding the whole response in RAM. Header-only, non-copyable, no dependencies.
keywords: stream, string, webserver, http, html, esp8266, esp32, embedded, arduino
